title: Exhibit an above-bar k=71 placement failing a three-stage deletion
body:
A T=447 labelled placement passes all 2,485 pair-deletion caps and averaged SUBDY rows, and has source type price above 128.891. Deleting stages {0,1,2} leaves capacity 324 against a requirement of 328.

## Scope and source

The pointwise deletion formula counts swallowed degree-two and degree-three masks. An explicit PIECE2 cut and local CROSS nodes also fail, so the scope is the named aggregate relaxation. The source extension is #7869 at `06c207a9feb3994a4b987dc3010657b6e85b7956`. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`. The included source manifest identifies every public dependency used.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-k71-triple-deletion/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory, check its checksum manifest, and run the extracted commands. Both standard-library checkers passed a fresh archive extraction. An independent replay reproduced the incidence counts and exact price interval [128.896193445305629,128.896193445305630]. Hosted execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Use pointwise triple cuts before pricing above-bar placements, with additional local CROSS and PIECE2 checks for any putative legal frame.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive. [Campaign board](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19789228).
